cells: The decision-producing language/runtime experiment `EXP-FHAR-10` was never run; no implementation language is selected and every resource, tail, FFI, cold-start and dependency-closure cell is unmeasured.
The ratified Option 2 target cannot be built and every later milestone bakes in concurrency, memory, packaging and fault semantics; a wrong base is expensive to unwind.

No canonical crash/replay benchmark ran between segmented JSONL + CAS and SQLite WAL + CAS; no store is selected, so exact replay digest, stale-writer exclusion and power-loss durability have no measured basis.
Blocks Milestone 2 (the canonical writer) and every durability, backup and recovery contract that consumes it.

The TLA+/TLC finite model, the 36 classified reachable mutants, the language-neutral byte-level vector corpus and two independent implementations do not exist; the four-function kernel freeze is conditional.
Without model, mutants and vectors the kernel cannot be frozen, and the language comparison of G-01 is not admissible because it needs the byte corpus first.

No OS native-semantics conformance fixtures or machine-readable platform-profile manifest exist; there are zero measured cells for containment, PTY/ConPTY teardown, atomic-replace durability, lock release or supervisor races.
Every process, terminal, filesystem and supervision contract the broker and canonical writer depend on is unqualified on the target Windows/Linux builds.

The IPC/process-broker protocol is only conditionally adopted; four freeze blockers (version negotiation, snapshot materialization, cursor rollover, ACK-release wording) and the native Windows/Linux chaos matrix are unpassed.
The v1 protocol cannot be frozen, and no detachable-terminal, slow-client isolation, containment or MCP-boundary claim is safe.
The availability/authority contract is undecided: may the single fenced canonical writer be temporarily unavailable after coordinator loss?
Decides whether consensus, automatic failover and multi-node authority are in v3 scope at all; the domain synthesis calls it the shared pivot.
No single PAUSE/Stop model is settled across configuration, the formal model and the broker; `checkpoint`/`interrupt`/`drain`/emergency and the drain allowlist remain unresolved.
The pause/stop vocabulary is the substrate for revocation, disconnect and admission; three surfaces currently disagree.
The 2-vCPU/4-GiB coordinator-small profile is a target, not a demonstrated capacity point; preflight "seconds", service-topology SLOs, watchdog timeouts and recovery decomposition are unverified.
Admission limits, recovery budgets and enterprise topology cannot be fixed without this capacity evidence.
The configuration architecture is frozen in design but has no cross-platform conformance corpus, no chosen human syntax and no agreed authority lattices for privacy exposure and publication.
Editors, edition gating, migration and the resolver cannot be built to a testable contract without it.
The renderer and the plugin runtime remain unselected across every lane.
Gates the terminal milestone and the plugin-isolation tier; DS-18 defers a WASI/WASM plugin-isolation evaluation.
Exact Windows build floors, Linux kernel/distribution profiles, WSL2 production status, SMB/NFS scope and the definition of "survives power loss" are undecided.

The deletion evidence contract has no negative-fixture run (copy ledger, key ledger, provider residual windows, disconnected spools); physical destruction on a lost node stays unknown.
